scope_correction: Actual-policy baseline uses the published 15.7TWh control; expansion benefits within listed industries are included. Nuclear and other unestimated increments remain excluded; this is a quantified subtotal and a model estimate with documented limitations.
government_comparison: The 15.7TWh official scheme-wide forecast corresponds to GBP628m at the exercise rate of GBP40/MWh. Manufacturing is its allocated subset, not the earlier full-industry baseline.
